race.comment: LITTLE BEGINNINGS (1) goes on top shouldering strong recent metro references, especially the Eagle Farm second when beaten a neck before a sound Doomben effort in BM85 company. The return of Osmond over a trip the gelding relishes adds to the case. RATENOTICE (8) has the sharpest track-and-distance profile, and her last run in the LR Tattersall's Members Cup is easier to mark forgivingly back to this level. Can return to winning ways. BATTLETON (2) has been freshened since a Gold Coast third in CL5 grade and has been kept up to the mark 42 days between runs with a solid trial. If they can utilise the inside draw on him, he'll get a good look at breaking a long drought. SUPER DUCK (7) was plain first-up at Doomben, but he is fitter and has peaks that can measure up for a minor slot.
